notes.title: Miniatures: Achievements Unlocked ✨
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616006/826d72e4b48c6cfe828dbbb9fb7032f96fcc1885.png[/img]

Whether you're someone who loves collecting them or enjoys the little “ping”, we’ve added four easy achievements to celebrate the anthology format of Miniatures 🦎🐚🪛🦋

[b]What to Expect: [/b]

- 4 achievements in total
- Simple and easy to find

The achievements were designed to be light — they’ll satisfy the collector’s heart, but will also keep the stories uninterrupted. 

If you’ve already visited these worlds, this might be a nice reason to return. And if you’re just arriving — happy exploring 💛
